title: Exploring the Limits of Zero Shot Vision Language Models for Hate Meme Detection: The Vulnerabilities and their Interpretations
findings: The study found that Islam was a primary target for religious hate in the evaluated meme datasets. Vision-Language Models often misclassified non-hateful memes as hateful if they contained common religious target words. The analysis revealed that models tend to excessively stereotype based on religious cues, leading to incorrect classifications.
